run_NVE_MolecularDynamics: run NVE molecular dynamics simulation on atomic structures using VelocityVerlet integrator with LBFGS relaxation
get_thermo_from_log: read thermo log files and return simulation time and total energy as numpy arrays
load_NVE_MD_dataset: load MD22 or TM23 dataset with atomic structures and their corresponding simulation temperatures
create_NVEMDRunner: create an NVEMDRunner instance with a calculator, input data, timestep, steps, and save frequency
write_MD_results: write molecular dynamics results by parsing thermo log files and extracting time and energy data
